name: HamkorBank
author: hamkorbank

sections.installation:
These steps should be made for module’s correct work:

  1. Sign documents with HamkorBank. To access the HamkorBank personal account, you need to fill a request form on the official HamkorBank website.

  2. Install and adjust the module. You can find the settings of this plugin in the “plugins” page of the admins’ console, or in WooCommerce settings page.

Next steps presume you already have WooCommerce module installed on your website.

  1. Module’s installation. Choose “Plugins → Add new” in admins’ console, press “Upload Plugin” button, choose zip-archive with plugin and then press “Install” button.
  2. Adjustment. Choose “WooCommerce → Settings” in admins’ console and proceed to “Payments” tab. Choose “HamkorBank” in the payment gateways list and proceed to settings.
    Fill in “Merchant ID” and “Secret Key” – these values can be found in https://my.hamkorbank.money. You can leave the rest settings as they go.
  3. After saving your settings, you will have HamkorBank payments available on your website.

sections.description:
It’s pretty easy to receive payments with HamkorBank Payments Provider.

International payment service for online business

Increase your profits with high-conversion payments. We will set up a convenient payment acceptance for your customers, and you can focus on developing your business!

External services

This plugin connects to an API to create payment requests. It’s necessary for the payment system to work.

It sends the payment request information, such as the cart data, payment amount, user’s IP every time the payment is created
(when user clicks on “Pay” button), if the user’s IP is not available, sends empty string.
This service is provided by “JSCB Hamkorbank”: terms of use, privacy policy.
